scope_statement: This is an explicit 38-technique Sensei runtime subset, not the complete 93-technique BCTTv1 taxonomy.
inclusion_criteria: Can be delivered conversationally by a non-clinical health and wellbeing coach
Supports goal clarification, planning, feedback, self-monitoring, social support, or confidence without diagnosing or prescribing
Can be represented with an observable strategy and evidence-grounded rationale
exclusion_criteria: Requires clinical diagnosis, medication management, coercion, material incentives, or specialist delivery
Cannot be safely or faithfully delivered in the current chat interaction
Duplicates an included technique for the bounded initial runtime use cases

technique_rationales.why_included: Supports a person-chosen behavioural goal.
Supports collaborative analysis of barriers and options.
Supports a person-chosen outcome without treating it as guaranteed.
Turns an agreed goal into a specific, voluntary next step.
Enables collaborative review and adjustment of behaviour goals.
Can compare grounded current behaviour with a chosen goal without shame.
Enables review of an outcome goal while preserving uncertainty.
Supports an explicitly chosen commitment without coercion.
Allows factual feedback on observed behaviour.
Supports user-controlled tracking of behaviour.
Supports user-controlled tracking of relevant outcomes.
Allows feedback from an available measurement device without diagnostic inference.
Allows grounded feedback on measured or self-reported outcomes.
Supports exploration of helpful social support.
Supports practical assistance chosen by the user.
Supports emotional encouragement without therapy claims.
Can provide requested, bounded how-to information.
Supports noticing context that precedes a behaviour.
Supports a small voluntary test rather than a rigid prescription.
Allows approved-source information about health consequences.
Supports discussion of social or environmental consequences.
Can illustrate a behaviour when a safe, appropriate example exists.
Supports user-chosen reminders and cues.
Supports practice of a non-clinical behavioural skill.
Supports replacing an unwanted routine with a chosen alternative.
Supports consistent repetition in a stable context.
Supports gradual, achievable progression.
Allows explicit connection to an approved credible source.
Supports non-directive exploration of advantages and disadvantages.
Supports non-clinical strategies for reducing distress around a chosen behaviour.
Supports user-controlled changes to the physical setting.
Supports user-controlled changes to the social setting.
Supports reducing exposure to user-identified unhelpful cues.
Supports adding a user-chosen object that makes action easier.
Supports a respectful alternative interpretation without disputing experience.
Supports grounded encouragement about capability without false certainty.
Can draw on the user's evidenced prior success.
Supports a user-chosen constructive self-statement.

excluded_categories.reason: Requires clinical or specialist delivery outside Sensei's role.
Uses coercion, material incentives, punishment, or unwanted social pressure.
Cannot be delivered observably and safely in the current chat scope.
